sloka: मतंग वनम् इति एव विश्रुतम् रघुनंदन ।इह ते भावित आत्मानो गुरवो मे महाद्युते ।जुहवान् चक्रिरे नीडम् मंत्रवत् मंत्र पूजितम् ॥३-७४-२२॥
transliteration: mataṁga vanam iti eva viśrutam raghunaṁdana ।iha te bhāvita ātmāno guravo me mahādyute ।juhavān cakrire nīḍam maṁtravat maṁtra pūjitam ॥3-74-22॥

translations.english: My precepters, who had perceived the Supreme Spirit made sacrificial offerings in this great garden, invoked gods through the power of mantras. They brought water and offered oblations to the sacrificial fire.
